key: O ye who believe! Forbid not the good things which Allah hath made lawful for you, and transgress not, Lo! Allah loveth not transgressors.
s: As rulings on food, oaths and strong drink begin, the believers are addressed; al-Tabari, on 5:87, takes ‘transgress not’ to bar any overstepping of God’s bounds, the companions who resolved to forbid themselves what He allowed being reproached for just that.

evidence.words: وكان الله تعالى ذكره قد عمَّ بقوله:"لا تعتدوا"، النهيَ عن العدوان كُلّه … وليس لأحدٍ أن يتعدَّى حدَّ الله تعالى في شي من الأشياء مما أحلَّ أو حرَّم … وذلك أن الذين همُّوا بما همُّوا به من تحريم بعض ما أحلَّ لهم على أنفسهم، إنما عوتبوا على ما همُّوا به من تجاوزهم ما سَنَّ لهم وحدَّ، إلى غيره.
evidence.gloss: God, exalted be His mention, made general with His words ‘transgress not’ the prohibition of all transgression … and no one may overstep God’s bound in anything He has made lawful or forbidden … For those who resolved as they did to forbid themselves some of what was made lawful for them were reproached only for resolving to pass beyond what had been laid down and bounded for them, to something else.

reason: Key verse verbatim (verse.js ok, Al-Ma’idah 5:87, at 755; the whole unit). Plain sense faithful: 5:87 opens a run on lawful food (5:87 to 5:88), oaths and their expiation (5:89) and strong drink and games of chance (5:90 to 5:93), addressed to the believers; no four-word run from the verse. In the packet on 5:87 al-Tabari reports three views of al-iʿtidaʾ (Uthman b. Mazʿun’s intended self-castration, per al-Suddi; the companions’ forbidding of women, food, clothing and sleep, per Ikrima; passing from the lawful to the forbidden, per al-Hasan), then gives his own: the prohibition is general, no one may overstep God’s bound in what He made lawful or forbidden, and the companions who resolved to forbid themselves what was lawful were reproached only for passing beyond what was laid down. The sentence carries that, attributed to him, without drift; ‘transgress not’ is two words of the key in curly quotes. Place ‘on 5:87’ is exact: his comment on 5:87 has its own heading within the seg. 43 words; entry-check ok.
